shortBio.en: Ramones bassist; 1-2-3-4 count-ins and early lyric drafts.
shortBio.zh: Ramones 贝斯手；1-2-3-4 起拍与早期歌词草稿。

body.en:
Born Douglas Colvin, 1951. Bass and many early count-ins/lyrics. Leaves 1989; later bassists continue tours. Count-in pedagogy on Blitzkrieg Bop is his clearest citation.

Writing + pocket more than flash technique.
body.zh:
本名 Douglas Colvin，1951 年生。贝斯与许多早期起拍/歌词。1989 离队；后期贝斯手续巡演。Blitzkrieg Bop 起拍教学是其最清晰引用。

写作 + 律动多于炫技。
